scope: P2-CLOUD-30 design only; no runtime implementation

new_specialized_public_capability.reason: ECCC SWOB cloud cover is a station observation and its static unit is not defined; it must not silently participate in the percent-based forecast intent.

shared_visual_cloud_layer.implementation_note: EUMETView needs machine-readable runtime coverage before it can safely participate when coverage_policy=required.

no_cross_product_satellite_fallback.reason: True Color, GeoColor, Clean Infrared, Visible Red and Air Mass have distinct product semantics, daylight behavior and temporal characteristics. One product class must not silently substitute another.

no_new_shared_nasa_product_class_intents.reason: Current regional variants are all provided by NASA GIBS. P2-CLOUD keeps them specialized rather than adding new abstractions without cross-provider need.

phenomena_policy.specialized_nasa_public_ids: preserve current metadata in P2-CLOUD; no blanket clouds tag for broad satellite products

unit_policy.eccc_observation: preserve provider runtime UOM; no implicit percent conversion

scoring_policy.satellite_layer: coverage and hard requirements before availability/freshness; no provider-name preference

implementation_requirements: Add explicit intent_contract metadata to weather.point.cloud_cover, weather.point.cloud_cover_low, weather.point.cloud_cover_mid and weather.point.cloud_cover_high.
Refine model candidate quantities to cloud_cover_fraction_total/low/mid/high.
Remove ECCC cloud_cover from weather.point.cloud_cover and expose it additively as weather.observation.cloud_cover.
Preserve the ECCC runtime provider UOM and do not normalize it to percent without verified equivalence.
Harden weather.satellite.clouds as a visual raster intent with DWD and EUMETView candidates.
Require machine-readable coverage for weather.satellite.clouds and add safe EUMETView runtime coverage if available.
Keep all existing NASA specialized satellite public ids unchanged.
Do not fall back across True Color, GeoColor, Clean Infrared, Visible Red and Air Mass product classes.
Preserve candidate-specific timeline, daylight limitations, attribution and provenance.
